C1661.title: Unauthorized Access Vulnerabilities in Credit Card APIs of 20 Banks
C1661.summary: A security research article reported that API security reviews found flaws in multiple bank APIs, with financial APIs facing unauthorized-access risks in open interfaces, authorization checks, and data-access controls. The case illustrates that open-banking and credit-card business APIs may expose sensitive account or transaction data if they lack fine-grained authentication, object-level access control, and abnormal-call monitoring.
